import math

# Alternative method: Calculate C(51,12) as product(40..51) / 12!
# This uses a different approach than standard iterative/math.comb methods

# Calculate the numerator: 40 × 41 × 42 × ... × 51
numerator = 1
for i in range(40, 52):
    numerator *= i

# Divide by 12!
c_51_12 = numerator // math.factorial(12)

# Calculate sum of decimal digits
digit_sum = sum(int(d) for d in str(c_51_12))

print("ANSWER: " + str(digit_sum))
